# SentinelOps

> Automated production-readiness scanner. Point it at a repository; it clones
> the code (read-only, never runs it), runs 33 checks across six categories —
> Security, Reliability, Deployment, Architecture, Scalability, Observability
> — and returns a score out of 100 with the exact finding behind every point
> lost.

SentinelOps never executes the scanned repository and makes no outbound
network calls from the sandbox that inspects it. Every check evaluates to
passed, flagged, skipped, or errored — never a bare pass/fail — and each
finding names the file and the fix.

## Pages

- [Home](/home): what it does, the pitch, the score
- [How it works](/how-it-works): the scan pipeline — clone, index, six
  scanners, 33 checks, weighted score — and the sandbox's own constraints
  (no network, read-only root, non-root user, hard memory/CPU caps)
- [Who it's for](/who-its-for): fits a containerized backend service about to
  go to production; does not fit static sites, libraries, notebooks, or a
  monorepo of several services scored as one unit

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Aboiaboiaboi/sentinelops): full source, README,
  and CHANGELOG
